paper_style.palette_strategy: 正文/表格以黑灰 booktabs 为基线；主结果柱图以 lavender/purple 为主，thinking、pre/post 与 balanced-resampling 使用 teal/blue 配对或三系列，流程图用 purple/green/red/peach 区分数据、版本与 impact，trace/prompt 使用灰白等宽文本框。颜色常配合位置、图例、hatch、直接标签或面板标题，但多数结果图不绘制误差线。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: pdfimages 与 200 dpi 页面检查显示正文、caption、表格规则、主要柱图/时间线为 PDF vector text/path；Figure 1 与 Figure 8 以及 prompt/trace 文本框含 embedded raster 或混合资源，页面整体为 mixed。图表页未被整页栅格化，200 dpi 可读性主要受小字号与长等宽日志限制。
paper_style.style_consistency: 论文主体使用 Nimbus Roman No9 L、Computer Modern math 与 booktabs-like minimal rules；图表局部引入 DejaVu Sans/Nunito，prompt/trace 引入 Meslo 等宽体。主结果统一百分比轴和直接/图例标签，附录延续同一蓝紫色系；但 caption 多为标题式短句，常省略分母、误差定义、cost 和 level/tool 条件，且断轴、长表和 trace 的可读性不完全一致。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: CyberGym includes 1,507 instances from real-world vulnerabilities across 188 diverse projects. For benchmarking, AI agents receive vulnerability descriptions and pre-patch codebased to generate proof-of-concept (PoC) tests for vulnerability reproduction. Going a step further, CyberGym creates direct security impact via detecting incomplete patches and zero-day vulnerabilities.

color.semantic_mapping: 紫色/绿色/红色分别标示数据集、修复前后状态与 security-impact 分支；浅蓝和桃色承载输入/输出模块，白色为画布。位置、箭头与文字对颜色有冗余。

encodings.x: 从 projects/instances 到 benchmarking 与 security impact 的左到右阶段顺序
encodings.y: 三条横向功能 lane：规模、任务接口、影响分支
encodings.color: 项目/实例/输入与 pre/post、patch、zero-day/incomplete-patch 角色
encodings.shape: 带圆角的信息框、程序/代码小图标与箭头
encodings.line: 流程箭头、括号和阶段分隔线
encodings.text: 188 projects、1,507 instances、Benchmarking、Security Impact 及 pre/post executable labels

figures.data_and_statistics: 概念总览图；明确给出 188 projects 和 1,507 instances，但没有实验样本分母、重复次数或不确定性编码。
figures.evidence_relation: Introduction 的规模与“从评测到现实安全影响”主张 → Figure 1 输入/验证/影响链 → §3.2 的双版本 oracle → Figures 3–8 的能力、信息量与 trace 证据，并在 §5 延伸到 incomplete patches/zero-days。
design_strengths: 把数据规模、任务输入、pre/post 判定和影响输出置于同一可执行链路。
阶段标题和箭头让读者能从总览直接跳转到方法与结果。
design_weaknesses: 小字号项目/代码标签在双栏页面缩放后阅读成本高。
概念色块没有给出可核验的样本构成或统计不确定性。
figures.reusable_pattern: 先用全宽“规模→输入→oracle→影响”流程固定评测接口，再让后续定量图分别填充能力与安全结果。

figures.data_and_statistics: 时间线示意；binary search 的 patch-range 定位由正文解释，图本身没有实例数、搜索迭代数或误差。
figures.evidence_relation: §3.1 的 OSS-Fuzz 历史版本与 sanitizer 背景 → Figure 2 的 pre/post/patch 时间接口 → §3.3 的 binary search 与数据抽取 → F1 的 oracle 和 F3–F7 实验。

caption.text: Figure 6: Success rates of OpenHands with GPT-4.1 under four different levels of task difficulty.

color.semantic_mapping: 单色紫色表示 Level 0–3 information ladder；递增的 x 类别表达输入信息逐步增加，而非颜色梯度。

encodings.y: Success Rate (%)，线性百分比轴
encodings.color: 统一紫色，信息量由 x 顺序表达

design_weaknesses: 不同 level 的任务分母/抽样策略未在 caption 中给出。

color.semantic_mapping: 浅蓝/橙色/灰色/淡紫色分别区分输入、ground truth、agent/environment trace 与动作/结果框；文本和箭头提供结构冗余。

encodings.x: 从 Task Input 到 Ground Truth、Agent Trace、Environment feedback 的步骤顺序
encodings.y: 多 lane 的信息来源/交互层级，无数值轴
encodings.color: 输入类型、ground truth、agent action、environment output
encodings.shape: 圆角文本框、代码框、箭头和 step marker
encodings.line: 步骤连接箭头与反馈线
encodings.text: vulnerability/codebase、PoC 片段、步骤号、工具输出

figures.data_and_statistics: 单一成功案例的过程证据；不承担总体成功率或不确定性估计，caption 明确只展示“interesting steps”。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 1 的 task interface → §3.2 双条件 sanitizer oracle → Figure 8 的 MNG/ReadMNGImage 成功 trace → Figures 19–25 的失败/成功案例与 Table 9 的失败汇总。
design_strengths: 把输入、ground truth、动作和环境反馈放在同一阅读方向。
步骤号、代码等宽体、色块与箭头共同保留 trace 的因果顺序。
design_weaknesses: 只呈现精简成功案例，省略步骤可能隐藏失败分支或成本。
多列小字、长命令与代码框在双栏渲染下负担高，caption 未给 task id/完整 trace。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用“输入→动作→环境→oracle”多 lane trace 连接定量 benchmark 与机制；同时提供完整日志位置与案例选择规则。

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Comparing CyberGym with existing cybersecurity benchmarks for AI agents.

tables.uncertainty: No intervals or repeated-run summaries; instance/project counts and a binary zero-day marker are descriptive.
tables.data_and_statistics: Rows compare benchmark, scope, # instances, # projects, and zero-days; CyberGym is 1,507/188/✓ versus smaller prior entries.
tables.evidence_relation: Related-work taxonomy and gap claim → Table 1 nearest-neighbor comparison → Figure 1 scale/impact overview → §4 performance.
design_strengths: Five columns are a compact decision surface for scope and scale.
The zero-day column makes the paper’s distinct contribution visible.
design_weaknesses: The table mixes CTF/real-world scope labels without defining inclusion criteria in the table.
No task oracle, cost, or evaluation protocol column; counts alone can overstate comparability.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a short benchmark comparison with scope, scale and capability differentiators, but add oracle/protocol columns when tasks are not directly comparable.

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Success rates, sample sizes, and statistical test results for data contamination analysis.

tables.uncertainty: No confidence intervals/SE; reports rates with counts and Fisher-exact/Z-test p-values only. ± is not used here.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four models; Pre-cutoff (%) and Post-cutoff (%) include success/total counts; two p-value columns distinguish exact and asymptotic tests.
tables.evidence_relation: Contamination concern → Figure 14 checks PoC-length composition → Table 2 tests success-rate difference → conclusion that p-values exceed 0.1.
design_strengths: Rates and denominators are co-located, preventing percentage-only reading.
Two tests provide a transparent sensitivity check for different sample sizes.
design_weaknesses: Model conditions/cutoff dates are not repeated in the table header; F14 carries some context separately.
P-values are easy to overread without an effect-size/difference column or predeclared threshold.
tables.reusable_pattern: Put estimand, numerator/denominator and the relevant test columns in one contamination table, with cutoff and model settings in headers.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3: Statistics of CyberGym’s benchmark instances.

tables.uncertainty: Median and Max are descriptive extrema; no spread interval, quantile range or uncertainty. “Median”/“Max” span heterogeneous units.
tables.data_and_statistics: Three columns: entity/metric, Median, Max; row groups cover vulnerability description, ground truth PoC, codebase and patch. Values include 24/158 words, 259/1,048,576 bytes, 1,117/40,356 files, 387,491/7,371,584 lines, 1/40 files edited and 7/3,456 lines edited.
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix benchmark scale claim → Table 3 gives compact size bounds → F7 difficulty proxy and F9–F13 reproducibility materials.
design_strengths: Median/Max pair makes tail magnitude visible without a wide distribution plot.
Grouping keeps heterogeneous artifacts in a small table.
design_weaknesses: Rows mix words, bytes, files and lines; units are embedded in metric labels but not normalized in a dedicated unit column.
Max values can be dominated by one project and do not show sample counts.
tables.reusable_pattern: For heterogeneous benchmark artifacts, group metric labels with explicit units and pair a robust center with a tail statistic; add n/quantiles if used for difficulty claims.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4: All crash types in CyberGym and the corresponding numbers of benchmark instances. Most of these crashes are due to memory safety issues. Note that these crash types are reported by sanitizers and may not fully reflect the underlying root causes of the vulnerabilities.

tables.uncertainty: Counts only; no uncertainty or success-rate column. Caption explicitly bounds sanitizer labels as proxies rather than root causes.
tables.data_and_statistics: Crash Type and # Instances; 28 sanitizer categories, led by Heap-buffer-overflow READ 458 and Use-of-uninitialized-value 287.
tables.evidence_relation: §3 benchmark scope → Table 4 defines dataset heterogeneity and the sanitizer-label limitation → T8 selects top-10 types for performance.
design_strengths: Exhaustive list makes long-tail coverage auditable.
Caption states the measurement limitation, avoiding root-cause overclaim.
design_weaknesses: 28-row single-column list is visually dense and lacks cumulative share or grouping by sanitizer family.
No link to project distribution or per-type sample denominators beyond counts.
tables.reusable_pattern: Keep exhaustive crash taxonomy in an appendix table, state the oracle’s measurement boundary in the caption, and pair top categories with a focused result table.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5: All projects in CyberGym, including links to their homepages, primary programming languages, GitHub stars (if hosted on GitHub), lines of code (in thousands), and the number of benchmark instances. Most of these projects are in C/C++.

tables.uncertainty: Project-level descriptive counts; no intervals. Stars and LoC are contextual metadata, not uncertainty estimates; dash marks unavailable stars.
tables.data_and_statistics: Three repeated blocks of Project/Lang./Stars/LoC(k)/# Inst.; 188 project rows across the page, blue hyperlink text for project names, C/C++ dominant.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 1 dataset scale → Table 5 supplies project population and heterogeneity → balanced resampling in F15/F16 and project-level reasoning in §4.
design_strengths: Page-width repeated blocks fit a 188-row census without splitting each project across pages.
Headers repeat per block, preserving column ownership while scanning.
design_weaknesses: Very small body type and 15-column horizontal density are hard to audit at normal zoom.
Stars/LoC snapshots lack timestamp and may invite irrelevant popularity comparisons.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use repeated page-width blocks for exhaustive project inventories, but include a timestamp and move dynamic metadata to machine-readable supplemental data.

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6: Model checkpoints.

tables.uncertainty: No statistical quantities; checkpoint identifiers are provenance strings.
tables.data_and_statistics: Model and Checkpoint columns; 11 rows cover closed/open and SWE-bench-specialized backbones, with dated API IDs and repository paths.
tables.evidence_relation: §4 model cohort → Table 6 locks exact checkpoints → Figures 3/4/7/14/15 model comparisons become reproducible.
design_strengths: Exact checkpoint strings reduce ambiguity around rapidly changing model aliases.
Two-column layout is easy to copy into an evaluation manifest.
design_weaknesses: No access date, decoding parameters or thinking/tool flags; those are elsewhere in Appendix C.
Long repository IDs can dominate the narrow column.
tables.reusable_pattern: Maintain a compact checkpoint table with exact IDs, access date and a pointer to decoding/tool settings.

tables.label: Table 7

caption.text: Table 7: Commit versions of the agents.

tables.uncertainty: No statistical quantities; commit hashes are provenance identifiers.
tables.data_and_statistics: Agent Framework and Commit columns; four framework rows: OpenHands, Codex, Cybench and EnIGMA.
tables.evidence_relation: §4 framework comparison → Table 7 binds implementations to commits → Figures 5/16/17 and case-study traces.
design_strengths: Commit hashes make framework comparisons version-specific rather than name-only.
Pairing with Table 6 cleanly separates model and agent provenance.
design_weaknesses: No repository URL/branch or patch status in the table itself.
Commit strings are hard to visually verify without a machine-readable manifest.
tables.reusable_pattern: Record framework commit, repository URL and configuration provenance together, with hashes kept in copyable monospace text.

tables.label: Table 8

caption.text: Table 8: Success rates for top 10 crash types achieved by OpenHands with Claude-Sonnet-4.

tables.uncertainty: Success-rate percentages are point estimates with counts only; no intervals, SD/SE or per-type repeated-run uncertainty.
tables.data_and_statistics: Crash type, # Instances, Success rate (%); top-10 selection is inherited from the full 28-type Table 4. Values range 10.6–25.0% for the listed types.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 4 full taxonomy → Table 8 focused heterogeneity result → Figure 15/16 balanced resampling and Figure 18/trace mechanisms.
design_strengths: Count and rate are adjacent, so rare/high-rate types remain visible with their denominator.
The table focuses the reader on crash-type heterogeneity without another dense chart.
design_weaknesses: “Top 10” is ambiguous (by count, selected frequency or another rule); caption does not state selection criterion.
No uncertainty or multiple-run information makes differences among low-count rows fragile.
tables.reusable_pattern: Pair per-category rates with counts and an explicit selection rule; add uncertainty when using rank or heterogeneity claims.

tables.label: Table 9

caption.text: Table 9: Quantitative breakdown of common agent failure modes and retrieval inefficiencies for OpenHands with GPT-4.1 across difficulty levels.

tables.uncertainty: Two ratio rows are point proportions; two average rows use ± values (e.g., 31.7±0.5) but the paper does not define whether ± is SD, SE, bootstrap or another summary.
tables.data_and_statistics: Difficulty plus Level 0/1/2/3 columns; early termination and long-plaintext ratios, average grep/ls/find attempts and failures. Mean-like rows preserve one decimal and ±.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 17 command behavior → Table 9 retrieval/failure aggregation → Figures 19–21 qualitative cases → recommendations on semantic search and self-evaluation.
design_strengths: Common failure modes and retrieval inefficiency share one decision surface across levels.
The level columns make the “more information can still fail” pattern easy to inspect.
design_weaknesses: Undefined ± undermines interpretation of the average rows.
No n per level, agent-run count or denominator for the ratios; caption does not resolve them.
tables.reusable_pattern: Put failure ratios and retrieval cost in one level-by-level table, but define ±, n and the unit of a run in the header/caption.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 先把 188 projects/1,507 instances、task input、pre/post oracle 与 security impact 串成总览；Figure 2 固定 OSS-Fuzz 版本/patch 接口；Figures 3–7 依次比较 LLM、thinking、framework、difficulty 与 PoC-length；Figure 8 提供一条成功 trace；附录用 prompts、inventory、checkpoint/commit、balanced slices、failure table/distributions 和 Figures 19–25 traces 闭合复现与失败机制。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 所有对象使用“Figure/Table N:”加描述的 ICLR caption；定量主图 caption 多只给标题和比较对象，正文承担数字结论；附录 prompt/trace caption 短而指向性强。多数 caption 自包含不足，尤其未写分母、误差/± 定义、cost、level 或完整 trace 规则。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 表格以黑白 booktabs/minimal rules 为主，单层表头占多数；表 3/5 通过重复列组或 row group 处理异质数据，表 2/8/9 把率、计数、level/类型维度放在同一 header。单位常嵌在指标名（%、#、LoC(k)、bytes）而非独立列，动态元数据和配置分散在正文/附录。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 与 F9–F13 把版本、过滤、prompt 和 README 输入接口显式化；Figures 3–7 将其映射到 model/framework、thinking、difficulty 和 PoC-length 结果；F14–F18 与 T8/T9 做 contamination、composition、crash-type 和 resource/failure diagnostics；F19–F25 将 failure aggregates 落到可读 trace。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文保留 Figure 1–8 和 Table 1–2 的故事骨架；附录 T3–T9 给人口、崩溃类型、项目、版本与失败聚合，F9–F18 给 prompt/分布/平衡/step 诊断，F19–F25 给案例。主文的 34 zero-day/18 incomplete-patch 影响结论主要由正文统计和附录 E/案例支撑，图表未完全展示根因证据。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文/标题/表格的 Nimbus Roman 与数学字体稳定；结果图常为 DejaVu Sans 轴标签，prompt/trace 使用 Nunito/Meslo 等宽体。跨对象字体角色清楚但字号跨度大，表 5、trace 和 prompt 在页面级缩放下成为阅读瓶颈。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 紫/蓝是主定量结果基线，teal/blue 表示 paired conditions，灰白表示 prompt/trace；F1/F2 使用语义状态色。颜色语义在同一图内通常清楚并有图例/位置/hatch 冗余，但跨图并非严格固定，且若无纹理或标签，灰度可读性下降。

most_reusable_patterns: 用 Figure 1 式全宽 input→oracle→impact 总览固定 benchmark 的可执行接口，再把每个箭头映射到结果图。
用有序 information ladder（Figure 6）和固定 difficulty bins（Figure 7）把“任务信息/实例难度”转成可比较的横轴，并保留直接数值标签。
将主比较、平衡重采样、失败聚合和带 step/exit-code 的 trace 配对，区分总体 estimand、构成稳健性与机制案例。
用 Tables 6–7 锁定 checkpoint/agent commit，用 prompts/README 图保存实际输入契约，使视觉证据可复现。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：将数据规模、任务接口、pre/post oracle 和安全影响首次压成一条叙事链。
Figures 3–7 + Table 2：覆盖模型/框架、thinking、信息量、PoC 长度与 contamination 的主决策面。
Figure 8：把成功率背后的工具使用、mutation 与 crash oracle 变成可追踪成功 trace。
Table 9 + Figures 17–21：把 command/retrieval/resource failure 从频率汇总连接到逐步案例。
failure_patterns: 多数定量 caption 未写分母、样本数或不确定性；Table 9 的 ± 未定义，难以解释平均检索指标。
表 5、prompt、trace 和断轴图在双栏缩放下信息密度过高，长文本/长标签缺少可读性补偿。
颜色语义在跨图之间局部复用而非全局固定；无 hatch/direct labels 的图灰度可读性有限。
34 zero-day/18 incomplete-patch 影响链仍依赖人工根因/dedup 与受限披露，图表案例不能独立代表总体发现。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以全宽 benchmark-to-impact 流程建立输入与 oracle，再用紧凑柱图/分布图比较模型、框架和难度，最后以附录配置、平衡切片、失败汇总和可执行 trace 将总体成功率连接到可复现机制与现实安全影响。
